reason: The unqualified `claude-box:latest` pod default does NOT live in the claude-box repo. It is in the sibling repo bounded-systems/prx: `packages/prx/src/room/claude-room.ts` line 29 sets `image: "claude-box"` on the claudeRoom RoomSpec, and `prx pod up --pod per-repo` composes that into a podman kube/compose spec (packages/prx/src/room/podman.ts), so podman resolves the bare name to docker.io/library/claude-box:latest. The code fix is a one-line constant change in prx (plus a test and a repin entry), following the pattern the other rooms already use. It is feasible without podman or GitHub creds since it is a string constant + unit test. The digest-pin variant (`@sha256:...`) is NOT feasible from the sandbox because the GHCR package is private and the digest cannot be read; a version tag pin is the achievable fully-qualified ref. The private-GHCR/docs half (make packages public, document `podman login ghcr.io` with read:packages) is an owner action and is out of scope. Note the task summary and verify criterion assume the change lands in claude-box; it must land in prx instead (or, if the executor is restricted to claude-box, the task is infeasible there and should be re-routed).

Run `bun test` in prx (and in claude-box if HOSTING.md is touched, `bun test && bun x tsc --noEmit`).

risks: Wrong repo: the task/verify criterion point at claude-box, but the bug is in bounded-systems/prx; an executor confined to claude-box cannot fix it and would find nothing to change.

Pulling the fully-qualified ref still fails on a fresh machine until the owner makes ghcr.io/bounded-systems/claude-box packages public or the user logs in — the fix only changes the error from a misleading docker.io denial to a correct GHCR auth denial.

Digest pin cannot be produced from the sandbox (private GHCR, no credentials); a tag pin (:0.8.0) is weaker than the sibling rooms' @sha256 pins and deviates from the design stance in HOSTING.md ('the digest is the pin').

Version skew: the pinned claude-room tag must exist on GHCR (release.yml/publish-ghcr.yml publish on tags); pinning 0.8.0 before that tag is published would 404. Verify the tag in the claude-box GitHub releases before choosing.
prx test suite may need podman for some room/pod tests; run only the room unit tests in the sandbox and rely on CI for the rest.
